pundit.name: Alexi Lalas
pundit.take:
**The Noisemaker's Chaos is Nothing but a Whimper in the World Cup Fantasy Realm**

Let me tell you something, Rafe, "The Noisemaker": utter chaos isn't a strategy, it's an admission of ignorance! Look at me, son. Three of your picks didn’t even qualify, and now you're languishing in last place with a pathetic 29 points. Germany and Mexico aren't a lifeboat in this sinking ship of yours, they're anchors. Meanwhile, "Mustard Boy" Zach, you're riding on Brazil's coattails like a guy desperately clutching onto a parachute that won't open. At 43 points, I can smell your fear from here, and believe me, it stinks of desperation. Gayden, the "Backpass Assassin," you're not passing the ball, you're passing the buck. England might get you to the Round of 16, but even with 52 points, you're coasting on borrowed time. Gunner, or should I say "Bubba G," you had France and lost to Spain! Gunner, your 81 points scream "runner-up" in a world that only remembers winners. And then we have you, Devin, a.k.a. "Ghost Pepper," sitting pretty with 92 points... but make no mistake, the crown's only yours until it's not. In this fantasy World Cup pool, you either win, or you face the shame of being second best. Choose wisely.
